scope: Continuation of the accepted C1 protocol: phases 3-7, author-clarified A; C2/C3 are outside this protocol

documented_extension.reason: The first attempt exposed an invalid harness assumption of an inverse linear tail by 4096. The sparse two-particle transient may be quadratic in initial length; retain the original horizon and extend the affected families.

random_law: numpy default_rng; independent Bernoulli bits at sparse density, uniform symbols 0..3 for uniform seeds; accept only both types, record full actual initial words
local_entropy: ln binomial(2*min(L,2r+1),particles in the graph-distance ball); each vertex counted once
recording: Every step: L, counts of both particles, merger measure, split/merge events, global entropy. Local entropy at t<=128 and every 16 steps afterwards. Raw CSV gzip plus exact initial/final words.
checks: named Lemma1 witnesses and independent engine equality
word projection against both named engines
strict lexicographic measure until merger disappearance
literal Theorem4 coefficient and corrected bound checked separately
interpretation: Finite trajectories are numerical support, never proof of asymptotics. Proof reconstruction is a separate document. No seed, horizon, or ensemble multiplicity attributed to the authors. Distinguish exact source reproduction from a new sampled illustration.
platform: assistant local, explicitly selected by owner
calibration: Separate execution before main; preparation excluded from code runtime; no duration cutoff.
